summary: The is_same_file test checks whether two paths resolve to the same filesystem object on the controller.
questions: How do I check if two local paths point to the same file?
Is is_same_file the same as same_file?

answer_card.title: is_same_file test
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.is_same_file` (same as `same_file`): true if two paths resolve to the same object on the **controller**.
